_doc: Sources the daily 'Registry refresh' workflow re-fetches, one per run (tools/refresh_source.py; see HANDOFF.md 'Scheduled registry refresh'). Each source's rows are identified by (external_id prefix, source string, breadth) groups; min_rows is an absolute floor (about 75% of the count when the source was added). Commands run from the repo root with the job's Python. raw = download/detail files deleted before a fetch (never geocode caches); caches = geocode caches persisted between runs (must match tools/*_scratch/*cache*.jsonl).
